Alexander Hutcheson-361 is retained as a lower-ranked candidate: his estimated 1630–1640 birth and unknown wife do not conflict by themselves, though his 1653 divinity degree and Scottish/Down ministry differ materially from the recorded Edinburgh tailor. A country-only filter was insufficient to reject him; no merger, marriage attachment or father inference follows.
